entries.title: Sources: Rapidus has yet to produce functioning SRAM, a key step that needed to be completed by summer 2026 to meet its March 2028 deadline for making 2nm chips (Takashi Mochizuki/Bloomberg)
A profile of Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy who founded Megaspeed with her business partner Kang Wei, who sources say was often introduced as her husband (New York Times)
Records show China's Northwestern Polytechnical University, which has close PLA ties, has access to Nvidia H200 AI chips despite being on a US export blacklist (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)
Researchers find that Grok Build is leaking data of over 35,000 apps via shareable links, including proprietary information, some belonging to SpaceXSI (Dan Goodin/Ars Technica)
Apple says its Apple Support Community forum will close permanently on November 20 and starting today the site is read-only and no longer accepts new posts (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
Sources: Jensen Huang's affair has significantly raised the chances of Congress enacting chip export limits this year via the National Defense Authorization Act (Politico)
Nvidia's stock fell 5.47% on Tuesday, following a 4%+ drop on Monday after the revelation of Jensen Huang's affair with Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy (April Roach/CNBC)
Source: CFTC warned Kalshi of possible imminent charges over failure to notify the regulator of certain products; Kalshi says it is addressing the issue (Declan Harty/Politico)
Tech consultant Nima Momeni was sentenced to 16 years to life in prison for the second-degree murder of Cash App founder Bob Lee in 2023 (Heather Knight/New York Times)
Anthropic opens its Australian retail IPO, giving individual investors access to Class A shares ahead of the company's planned Nasdaq listing (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
How US-based game publishers are losing ground in the $121B mobile gaming market to Chinese rivals, which can make games quicker, cheaper, and more profitably (Bloomberg)
An analysis of the tech job market in late 2026: product managers seem to be benefiting most in the AI era, demand for engineers is plateauing, and more (Lenny Rachitsky/Lenny's Newsletter)
Sources: Anthropic's bankers are weighing plans to raise its IPO price following heavy demand, which could increase the valuation target to $1.5T or more (Financial Times)
A deep dive into AMD's Zen 6 EPYC Venice: it uses TSMC's N2P, the 9686F often beats Nvidia's Vera, a dual 9996 is up to 93% faster than a dual Zen 5 9965, more (Jake Roach/Tom's Hardware)
NY-based Daylight, which provides AI-powered managed security, raised an $80M Series B led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, sources say at a ~$400M valuation (Maria Armental/Wall Street Journal)
